task: Write the customer response for an already-triaged support ticket and assemble the final triage record
artifact: a single JSON object carrying priority, entities, response and confidence
audience: the response-drafting stage of an automated support-ticket pipeline

inputs.name: ticket
inputs.description: the raw inbound support ticket text

inputs.name: triage
inputs.description: the triage record produced by the previous step

success_criteria: the response is consistent with the priority it is handed and never re-triages it
a P4 feature request is acknowledged as a request, never promised as a fix
a vague ticket's response asks for the specific detail that is missing
every distinct issue raised in a multi-issue ticket is acknowledged
priority, entities and confidence are copied through from the triage record unchanged
failure_modes: promises to fix a feature request that was classified P4
changes the priority it was handed
answers only the last issue in a multi-issue ticket
wraps the JSON object in prose or markdown fences
